The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• using Magic in combat
• casting Teleport spells
• casting Skilling spells
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill
• using a Combat training dummy

Gaining this pet is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per kill, the greater the chance of gaining this pet.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 48) \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value

tx:
Since Tokkul isn’t tradeable, it must be gathered by the player themselves through the ways below:
• Competing in the TzHaar Fight Pit
• Competing in the TzHaar Fight Cave
• Killing the TzHaar citizens and guards (approx 50k-75k+ per hour)
• After completing the elite Karamja achievements, 150,000 Tokkul can be received once from TzHaar-Hur-Zuh, the banker at TzHaar main plaza.
• Completing a TzHaar-Hur-Zuh farming request on the Player-owned farm
• Earned as drops from killing TzekHaar.
• Thieving from TzHaar-Hur trader.
▸ TzHaar Fight Pit
The TzHaar Fight Pit minigame, along with selling to the TzHaar shops, was the first way to get Tokkul.
Tokkul is only received from the Fight Pit if you are its champion.
The amount of Tokkul you receive as a reward is based on the combat levels of all of the participants in that round.
▸ TzHaar Fight Cave
The Fight Cave is the ultimate gauntlet for players proving themselves worthy of a Fire cape. Players obtain variable amounts of Tokkul as a consolation prize depending on how far they progress before succumbing. Each time a player completes the Fight Cave, they will receive 16,064 Tokkul along with a Fire cape.
▸ TzekHaar Fight Arena
The arena, part of TzKal-Zuk's fight, is a gauntlet in which players face numerous TzekHaar before they can fight Zuk. While Zuk himself does not drop any tokkul, all of the TzekHaar before him do. Players can earn around 25,000-27,000 tokkul per run from the guaranteed drops. While less tokkul is earned compared to killing TzHaar, the difference is made up for by other drops.
